first_restore.entry: Two ordinary desktop Chromium windows with native-operation delivery controlled over one real synthetic Rust workspace.
first_restore.before: The peer committed source B and displayed 106. Refocusing the first waiting window admitted no new workspace snapshot; after A arrived it showed 44.
first_restore.after: A focus-triggered snapshot gated the first reopen. An A reply delivered before the snapshot or after B rendered could not display. An independent source B still showed 106, and confirmation of the unchanged A restored 44.

folder_refresh.entry: The actual published folder drawer with synthetic native replies, three independent revision identities and a delayed positive status.
folder_refresh.before: A successful refresh listed the previously withheld revision but issued no new status read.
folder_refresh.after: The drawer kept the entry hidden until verified status arrived, then reopened the available revision with close 58 and its provenance. A still-missing revision stayed hidden. The explicitly revoked revision was neither rechecked nor shown.

qualification: Focused Linux Chromium verification with the real portable writer where applicable. The checked-in Rust storage path, protocol, and completed M2-033, M2-034, and M2-035 records remain unchanged. Native Windows and the separate shared-bar read timeout have their own scope.
